finance_refinement_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand.
Edit this revive "07 / KADER" complete moodboard to feel A BIT MORE LIKE A CREDIBLE BUSINESS-FINANCE BRAND while retaining its distinctive bold upright typography, orange/black/white palette and original graphic-grid idea. Same 1536x1024 landscape format and full brand-system content.

KEEP: exact recognizable upright heavy lowercase revive wordmark with tiny orange square at inner shoulder of the r and square i dot; r integrated as first letter; no Capital. Keep black, white, #FF6B2D orange and #979797 grey palette. Keep label "07 / KADER", GT Eesti Display type specimen, logo variations, isolated r icon, business photo, graphic specimens, icons, desktop/mobile/proposal mockups. Keep both original slogans verbatim, no new slogans:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."

FINANCE REFINEMENT:
- More premium financial-editorial balance: white and carbon dominant, orange approximately 15–20% of the board used for key decisions and compact modules. Transform the huge orange main-logo surround into mostly white with a narrower decisive orange side strip or top bar. Keep large bold revive but give it more white breathing room.
- Make grid lines thinner and lighter; retain them as disciplined alignment and subtle rows/columns. Reduce registration crosses and oversized technical photo brackets. Graphic language should evoke financial structure, clarity and progress. Keep tiny square accents and restrained orange corner markers, no industrial test-lab styling.
- Financing becomes explicit in realistic mockups. The website must show the exact second slogan plus a tidy financing summary panel with labels "Financieringsbedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag"; use long dashes as empty concept values, NO fabricated amounts, rates or claims. Show a small clear "Bekijk voorstel" button. Strong typography and sensible whitespace.
- Mobile screen header "Je financiering", clean structured document/summary view, three short financing labels "Bedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag" with em-dash values, then a sober progress sequence "Aanvraag" / "Beoordeling" / "Voorstel" and "Bekijk voorstel" call to action. Orange guides attention, not decoration.
- Printed proposal: visibly a professionally typeset financing proposal, clean white cover and deep carbon wordmark, small orange edge marker, fine table/row structure with labels "Financieringsvoorstel", "Bedrag", "Looptijd", "Maandbedrag". Small graphic square module rather than a large architecture photo or big orange slab.
- Business photography: natural documentary scene of a business owner and finance adviser carefully reviewing a proposal with laptop and organized financial documents in a contemporary professional office. Keep monochrome photographic treatment, credible engaged expressions, not handshake clichés. Crop tighter around interaction and proposal; restrained single orange corner detail.
- Icon family: document, calculator, calendar, check, all simple coherent outlines. Main three-step process "01 Aanvraag", "02 Beoordeling", "03 Voorstel". This is explanatory UI, never an invented claim of automatic approval.
- Keep assertive type, high contrast, Swiss editorial quality. Do not soften into wellness design. No blue added, no racing, military terminology, government insignia, generic stock charts, fake financial data or tiny filler copy.

Only functional finance labels specified above may be added; do not invent taglines, fake addresses, monetary values, certifications or performance claims. This is a controlled business-finance refinement of Kader, not a different identity.

name: 07 — Kader
description: Een nieuwe richting met een rechtopstaand, zwaar woordmerk, een zichtbaar raster en oranje kaders. Kleine vierkante modules verbinden de grafische taal met zakelijke fotografie en heldere financieringstoepassingen.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE complete, art-directed brand identity moodboard for the Dutch business-finance brand "revive". New direction title: "07 / KADER". Landscape 1536x1024, exceptionally clear print-design presentation.

Input images 1 and 2 are VISUAL STYLE REFERENCES only: extract their bold upright grotesk typography, exposed fine square grid, orange/black/white rectangular editorial composition, tiny alignment crosses, modular labels and dramatic scale contrast. Create original revive branding; DO NOT reproduce their words, insignia, R1, flags, registered marks, defence content or military meaning.

THE NEW DIRECTION: confident financial precision, capable people getting business funding organised. Strong and direct, structured and credible. Upright rather than italic. A strict visible grid is the brand's graphic system: fine rules, occasional small registration crosses at panel intersections, square modules extracted from the grid, orange brackets that frame a photo or important answer. Tiny square pixels remain as precise details in the system, not dissolving clouds. A few subtle closely spaced hatch lines confined to ONE small grid cell, if useful. No slanted racing stripes, speed trails, cars, automotive scenes, sci-fi HUDs or medical imagery. No pink or pastel palette.

WORDMARK: huge distinctive lowercase "revive", exactly six letters r-e-v-i-v-e, set in an ultra-bold UPRIGHT closely fitted neo-grotesk with crisp flat terminals, substantial weight, open recognizable counters and round internal curves like the typography of the references. The first r IS integrated as the first letter of the word, equal x-height/baseline/stroke weight to e/v; never a separate monogram preceding a second r. Design a tiny square grid notch at the inner shoulder of the first r to make the mark ownable while keeping it immediately legible. Square dot on i. No pixel spray in the wordmark. Show this same wordmark in black on white, white on carbon and black on orange, plus a standalone first-r app icon derived exactly from the first letter. No "capital". No ®/TM.

COLOUR: use four flat colour chips with accurate readable labels:
"Oranje #FF6B2D"
"Carbon #202020"
"Wit #FFFFFF"
"Grijs #979797".
Typography specimen: "GT Eesti Display" supporting type reference with "Aa" and "0123456789", upright strong weights; custom wordmark independent.

BOARD CONTENT / ART DIRECTION:
Build a striking cohesive modular identity board, not a collection of generic rounded cards. Use the graphic grid as the backbone and let panels align exactly across the composition. Main large orange zone with oversize black revive wordmark on an inset white rectangle and small black registration crosses; big clear areas of orange. A black zone with enormous white headline and subtle grey grid lines. A second rectilinear zone with monochrome business photography of two entrepreneurs and a financial adviser reviewing a proposal at a contemporary office table; documentary, professional, intelligent, realistic, no aprons/workshop/cars. Use a precise orange photo bracket and one 2x2 micro-square module to connect photography with the graphic language.
Include clearly visible: hero wordmark; small logo/reverse/icon specimens; palette; supporting type; standalone graphic-elements specimens (grid, bracket, four tiny square modules, registration mark); a consistent thin rectilinear icon family (document, person, check, forward); three-step financing process "01 Aanvraag" / "02 Beoordeling" / "03 Antwoord".
Show fully branded applications in the lower part: a clean desktop finance website, a compact mobile finance screen and a flat printed business proposal / correspondence cover. Arrange on neutral surfaces with grid-led content, strong black text, white backgrounds and orange status bars/buttons. These must demonstrate the same new typographic system, not the old italic logo. Have one large typographic print/poster specimen in the board so the source inspiration is clear. Use generous whitespace and decisive type scale.

EXACT MARKETING COPY, only these two slogans, legible and correctly spelled:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
Put first as the main large editorial statement across a graphic block. Put second on the website/poster application. No invented marketing lines, no guarantees, no fake amounts, statistics, certifications or deployment IDs.
Other text only functional labels: "07 / KADER", "revive", "Logo", "Kleuren", "Typografie", "Grafische elementen", "Fotografie", "Iconen", "Website", "App", "Voorstel", "Aanvraag", "Beoordeling", "Antwoord", "Bekijk aanvraag", "Je aanvraag", and the palette/font/type/process labels specified above. Avoid filler paragraphs and microscopic nonsense.
Polished original Dutch fintech brand system, distinctly bold Swiss/editorial grid inspiration, businesslike and assertive. Full complete moodboard, tightly coherent, high contrast, sharp clean typography and graphic design.
